# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> CBPM Real Estate is delighted to bring to the market this spacious and well-proportioned 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom semi-detached home, ideally located at 37 Lake Drive in the popular residential area of Kilminchy, Portlaoise. Built in 2003 and extending to approximately 117.64 m² (1,266 sq. ft.
